verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The display is split over two fields of the same structure: `decomposition` gives u w = spatialCurl A w + D w, and `direct_angular` gives D = angularField b on the same set; substituting the second into the first is exactly u = curl 𝒜 + ℬe_θ, since angularField b w = (b(cylPoint w)/r)·(-x₂, x₁, 0) and |(-x₂, x₁, 0)| = r. The paper's 'axisymmetric scalar ℬ' is the Lean's `Coefficient`, a function of (t, r, z), so axisymmetry is built into the type rather than asserted. The Lean asserts the identity on {w | w.1 < 1} (that is τ > 0), which contains the paper's Ω_* = {τ > 0, q < q_*}, so the Lean clause gives the paper's on Ω_*. The accompanying prose of clause (i) (Cartesian smoothness at the axis, exact divergence-freeness) is carried by the separate fields `potential_smooth`, `direct_smooth` and `divergence_free`, not by this display.
